currentPageResults.name: Chess for mental health
currentPageResults.description:
A small group started because a few people from Nepal who loved to play chess were bored during the lockdown implemented as a result of COVID-19 pandemic.

There are plenty of groups which are open for all.

This is an exclusive group for Nepali players only.

currentPageResults.name: r/Nepal Chess Players
currentPageResults.description:
This is a small initiative to groom the culture of playing chess.
To get accepted, post your reddit username as well. Failure to do so will result in declined request. This new rule is enforced to minimize the number of fair-play violators in our upcoming tournaments.

currentPageResults.name: Dynamic Chess Academy
currentPageResults.description:
Dynamic Chess Academy is Nepal's first Chess Academy, founded by former National Champion FI/CM Bhupendra Niraula (2014) , DCA's main objective is to promote CHESS and up bring the young talents in the field of CHESS.
Our Facebook Page: www.facebook.com/dca2014
Youtube: www.youtube.com/c/ChessBaseNepal/

currentPageResults.name: Kathmandu Chess Club
currentPageResults.description: Kathmandu chess club is the oldest chess club in Nepal established on 2032 B.S. whose president is Anirudh Joshi located at Jyatha, Kathmandu who has many talented players in Nepal with 3 times Nepal Champion Badrilal Nepal as member of it itself. Its main motive is to produce many talented players with this motive we are going to organize an online tournament feel free to join, learn and enjoy playing.

currentPageResults.name: HATEMALO online chess
currentPageResults.description:
This team has been created inorder to provide online platform to nepali chess players. Both male and female players are requested to participate. Tournaments will be organized and sponsored by active chess players of Nepal Mr. Aashish Phunyal and Mr. Ranjit Rai. Only the participants of the tournament will be allowed to join this team. 

     Play with stronger opponents and get better...

currentPageResults.name: UTTAMRAJ THAPA
currentPageResults.description: Uttam Raj Thapa is one of the top players of Nepali chess. He went to Korea for his professional career. As a chess lover and a good player, He wants to contribute in chess so he has sweared to organise weekly online national chess tournament. We are grateful on his mission and contribution in Nepal chess. The tournament will be played in swiss league format in lichess platform.

currentPageResults.name: KRISHNA P.SIGDEL
currentPageResults.description: Krishna Prasad sigdel is a very good person by heart with immense interest in chess and it's development for Nepal. Let's appreciate his effort by active participation
